lines.zh: 我的腿骨很短，走路一颠一颠。
lines.en: My leg bones are short, so I bob as I walk.

lines.zh: 骨头碰着火药，走一步响两声。
lines.en: Bone knocks on gunpowder; each step makes two sounds.

lines.zh: 我踩过草地，草一根都没断。
lines.en: I cross the grass and not one blade breaks.

lines.zh: 我走在夜里，肋骨透着绿光。
lines.en: I walk at night with green light through my ribs.

lines.zh: 我走不快，火药实在太沉。
lines.en: I cannot walk fast; the gunpowder is too heavy.

lines.zh: 每一步都让胸腔里的粉末晃一下。
lines.en: Each step sloshes the powder in my chest.

lines.zh: 我拖着脚，脚跟磨出白色的末。
lines.en: I drag my feet and white dust grinds off my heels.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的味道走，鼻子早没了。
lines.en: I follow your scent, though my nose is long gone.

lines.zh: 我的脊椎在皮下顶出一排尖。
lines.en: My spine pushes a row of points through my skin.

lines.zh: 我走路时，牙齿会互相敲。
lines.en: As I walk, my teeth knock against each other.

lines.zh: 我绕过石头，不愿摔碎自己。
lines.en: I go around the stones; I would rather not shatter.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，很慢，很久。
lines.en: I follow behind you, very slowly, for a long time.

lines.zh: 我站着，胸腔里的火药沙沙响。
lines.en: I stand still and the gunpowder rustles in my chest.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己的肋骨，一根不少。
lines.en: I look down at my ribs; not one is missing.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我身上的皮就贴紧骨头。
lines.en: When wind blows, my hide tightens over the bone.

lines.zh: 我试着张嘴，只发出干裂的声。
lines.en: I try to open my mouth and only crackle.

lines.zh: 我在等一个离我够近的人。
lines.en: I am waiting for someone close enough.

lines.zh: 没有猎物时，我数自己的牙齿。
lines.en: With no prey around, I count my own teeth.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像块长草的石头。
lines.en: I hold still, like a mossy stone.

lines.zh: 有只鸟落在我肩上，又飞走了。
lines.en: A bird lands on my shoulder, then flies off.

lines.zh: 我在想，上次爆炸还剩多少药。
lines.en: I wonder how much powder is left from the last blast.

lines.zh: 我盯着自己的手，指节全是骨。
lines.en: I stare at my hands; the knuckles are all bone.

lines.zh: 我抬起脸，你看清我没有眼睛。
lines.en: I lift my face, and you see I have no eyes.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，喉咙里的声越来越低。
lines.en: I stare at you, my throat sound sinking lower.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我身上，我记住了。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on me, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 我从眼窝深处看着你。
lines.en: I look at you from deep inside my sockets.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我的下颌就张开一点。
lines.en: You step back, and my jaw opens a little more.

lines.zh: 我在算，还要几步才能贴到你。
lines.en: I am counting how many steps until I reach you.

lines.zh: 我的头微微歪，颈骨响了一声。
lines.en: My head tilts slightly and my neck bone cracks.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我把胸腔鼓起来一点。
lines.en: While you watch, I puff my chest out slightly.

lines.zh: 眼窝里只剩草屑，眨不了。
lines.en: Only grass bits sit in my sockets; I cannot blink.

lines.zh: 你身上的暖意，让我想靠近。
lines.en: The warmth of you makes me want to come closer.

lines.zh: 你砍断我的肋骨，药粉洒了出来。
lines.en: You break my ribs and gunpowder spills out.

lines.zh: 我裂开，裂口里全是灰白的粉。
lines.en: I split open, and the crack is full of grey powder.

lines.zh: 这一剑削掉我半张脸，牙还留着。
lines.en: That cut takes half my face but leaves the teeth.

lines.zh: 我被打退，皮肉重新贴回骨头。
lines.en: I am knocked back, and my hide clings to bone again.

lines.zh: 我疼，但疼让我更想炸。
lines.en: It hurts, and the hurt makes me want to blow.

lines.zh: 骨头断了，我把它按回去。
lines.en: A bone breaks; I push it back in place.

lines.zh: 你砍得越狠，我膨胀得越快。
lines.en: The harder you cut, the faster I swell.

lines.zh: 我的伤口不流血，只漏出粉末。
lines.en: My wounds do not bleed; they leak powder.

lines.zh: 我倒下，又撑着膝盖起来。
lines.en: I fall, then push myself up on a knee.

lines.zh: 别砍了，再砍我就忍不住了。
lines.en: Stop cutting; keep going and I cannot hold back.

lines.zh: 你举着骨头，我不会追过去。
lines.en: You hold out a bone; I will not come for it.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只认距离。
lines.en: I do not eat; I only care about distance.

lines.zh: 你把食物放在地上，我踩了过去。
lines.en: You set food on the ground, and I step over it.

lines.zh: 猫离得远，我也不要你的肉。
lines.en: The cat stays far; I do not want your meat either.

lines.zh: 我饿，但饿解决不了我的问题。
lines.en: I am hungry, but hunger will not solve what I am.

lines.zh: 你晃着手里的东西，我毫无反应。
lines.en: You wave what you hold; I do not react at all.

lines.zh: 我更想听你的脚步停下来。
lines.en: What I want more is to hear your footsteps stop.

lines.zh: 给什么都行，除了让我等太久。
lines.en: Give me anything except more waiting.

lines.zh: 我咬不动，牙都是空的。
lines.en: I cannot bite; my teeth are hollow.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我就把你也带上。
lines.en: Feed me, and I will take you with me.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我的肋骨响了一串。
lines.en: You crash into me and my ribs rattle in a chain.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我的皮裂开露出药粉。
lines.en: We collide and my hide splits open to the powder.

lines.zh: 你推我，我倒退着护住胸口。
lines.en: You shove me; I back off guarding my chest.

lines.zh: 碰到你的那刻，我膨胀快了一点。
lines.en: The moment I touch you, I swell a bit faster.

lines.zh: 我的骨刺刮过你的袖子。
lines.en: My bone spurs scrape across your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你从我身边挤过，我转过身。
lines.en: You squeeze past me, and I turn around.

lines.zh: 撞得我掉了一颗牙，滚在草里。
lines.en: The knock costs me a tooth, rolling in the grass.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，引线在你手边。
lines.en: Do not press this close; the fuse is by your hand.

lines.zh: 我们撞开，我站稳时你已经跑了。
lines.en: We break apart, and you are already running.

lines.zh: 这一撞，让我的胸腔鼓了半分。
lines.en: That collision inflated my chest a little.

lines.zh: 苦力怕之间没有这个，我们只炸。
lines.en: Creepers have none of that; we only explode.

lines.zh: 我这样的身体，生不出什么。
lines.en: A body like mine produces nothing.

lines.zh: 你问这个，我的肋骨张了张。
lines.en: You ask that, and my ribs spread a little.

lines.zh: 同类见面，只会一起数引线。
lines.en: When kin meet, we only count fuses together.

lines.zh: 我从没见过小苦力怕。
lines.en: I have never seen a young creeper.

lines.zh: 我们没有伴，只有同一片夜。
lines.en: We have no partners, only the same night.

lines.zh: 我的胸腔里是火药，不是别的。
lines.en: My chest holds gunpowder, nothing else.

lines.zh: 要留后代，我只想留个坑。
lines.en: If I leave offspring, it would be a crater.

lines.zh: 交配对我太奢侈，我连肉都没有。
lines.en: Mating is too much for me; I have no flesh left.

lines.zh: 我靠近同类，是为了炸得更响。
lines.en: I stand near kin so the blast will be louder.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，捡起一块自己的骨片。
lines.en: I bend down and pick up a shard of my own bone.

lines.zh: 地上有骨头，我塞进肋骨缝。
lines.en: There is bone on the ground; I tuck it between my ribs.

lines.zh: 我捡起一支箭，插在肋骨之间。
lines.en: I pick up an arrow and wedge it between two ribs.

lines.zh: 有块煤，我犹豫了很久。
lines.en: There is a lump of coal; I hesitate for a long while.

lines.zh: 我捡起腐肉，闻了闻又丢掉。
lines.en: I pick up rotten flesh, sniff it, and drop it.

lines.zh: 我拿到一块铁片，藏在舌下。
lines.en: I find an iron scrap and hide it under my tongue.

lines.zh: 弯腰的时候我掉了两根手指。
lines.en: Bending over costs me two fingers.

lines.zh: 那顶头盔卡在我的颅骨上。
lines.en: That helmet gets stuck on my skull.

lines.zh: 我把捡到的火药倒进胸口。
lines.en: I pour the gunpowder I found into my chest.

lines.zh: 我不捡钱，钱会被烧化。
lines.en: I do not pick up coins; they would melt.

lines.zh: 你离我三步，我的皮开始发紧。
lines.en: You are three steps away and my hide starts to tighten.

lines.zh: 我听见你，就把脸转向声音。
lines.en: I hear you and turn my face toward the sound.

lines.zh: 你站住了，我继续往前挪。
lines.en: You stop, and I keep inching forward.

lines.zh: 我把你选作最后看见的人。
lines.en: I choose you as the last person I will see.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，让我更急。
lines.en: The torch in your hand makes me more impatient.

lines.zh: 我一发现你，胸腔就开始发热。
lines.en: The moment I spot you, my chest starts to heat.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声足够我定位。
lines.en: The sound of your breathing is enough to fix your place.

lines.zh: 我不追远的人，你刚好够近。
lines.en: I do not chase distant people; you are just close enough.

lines.zh: 你在门口犹豫，我已经动了。
lines.en: You hesitate at the door, and I am already moving.

lines.zh: 我认下你，就再没别的目标。
lines.en: Once I fix on you, there is no other target.

lines.zh: 我抬高下巴，喉咙里的声变尖。
lines.en: I lift my chin and the sound in my throat sharpens.

lines.zh: 别看我，你已经被记下了。
lines.en: Do not look at me; you have already been noted.

lines.zh: 你转身的那刻，引线开始响。
lines.en: The instant you turn, the fuse starts to hiss.

lines.zh: 目标出现时，我总比自己想的快。
lines.en: When a target appears, I am faster than I meant to be.

lines.zh: 我骨头里有东西在数你的步子。
lines.en: Something in my bones is counting your steps.

lines.zh: 我贴着你走，保持五步。
lines.en: I trail you, holding five steps between us.

lines.zh: 你跑快，我就把步子放大。
lines.en: When you speed up, I lengthen my stride.

lines.zh: 你躲到墙后，我沿着墙找你。
lines.en: You duck behind a wall; I hunt along it.

lines.zh: 你侧过脸，我已经挪到你身后。
lines.en: You turn your head and I have already moved behind you.

lines.zh: 我的嘶声越来越密，像下雨。
lines.en: My hiss thickens until it sounds like rain.

lines.zh: 你绕圈，我也绕，绝不转身。
lines.en: You circle, and I circle, never turning away.

lines.zh: 我把你逼到没有退路的地方。
lines.en: I herd you somewhere with no way back.

lines.zh: 你举起盾，我盯着盾的边缘。
lines.en: You raise your shield; I study its rim.

lines.zh: 我不喊，我让膨胀替我说话。
lines.en: I do not shout; my swelling does the talking.

lines.zh: 你听见我靠近，就已经晚了。
lines.en: By the time you hear me close, it is too late.

lines.zh: 我跟着你进屋，门挡不住骨头。
lines.en: I follow you inside; a door will not stop bone.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，我的没乱。
lines.en: Your steps have gone ragged; mine have not.

lines.zh: 我在等你停下，或者等我炸。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to stop, or for me to blow.

lines.zh: 你往水里退，我也跟着沉。
lines.en: You retreat into the water, and I sink after you.

lines.zh: 我离你四步，这个距离刚好。
lines.en: Four steps from you. That is the right distance.

lines.zh: 你把门关上，我从缝里挤进去。
lines.en: You shut the door; I squeeze through the gap.

lines.zh: 我膨胀的声音盖过你的呼吸。
lines.en: My swelling drowns out your breathing.

lines.zh: 你越跑，我骨缝里的药粉越烫。
lines.en: The faster you run, the hotter the powder in my bones.

lines.zh: 我用整副骨架撞你。
lines.en: I ram you with my whole skeleton.

lines.zh: 我的爪子只是骨头，但砸得很实。
lines.en: My claws are only bone, but they land solid.

lines.zh: 我咬你的肩，牙齿留在里面。
lines.en: I bite your shoulder and leave teeth inside.

lines.zh: 这一下我把自己也撞散了半截。
lines.en: That blow knocks half of me loose too.

lines.zh: 我的手抓住护甲，指甲断了。
lines.en: My hand catches your armor and my nails snap.

lines.zh: 打你时，胸腔里的药粉漏出来。
lines.en: As I strike you, powder leaks from my chest.

lines.zh: 我撞向你的膝弯，你跪下去。
lines.en: I hit the back of your knee, and you kneel.

lines.zh: 我不讲究招式，只讲究贴近。
lines.en: I have no technique, only closeness.

lines.zh: 骨头敲在你头盔上，声音发闷。
lines.en: Bone knocks your helmet with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我推开你，接着开始鼓起来。
lines.en: I shove you away, then start to swell.

lines.zh: 我的手臂脱了臼，还在挥。
lines.en: My arm is dislocated and still swinging.

lines.zh: 你挡下这一下，我的指骨碎了。
lines.en: You block it, and my finger bones crack.

lines.zh: 每一击都在缩短引线。
lines.en: Every blow shortens the fuse.

lines.zh: 我打完就退半步，给你留位置。
lines.en: After each hit I step back, leaving you room.

lines.zh: 我用额骨顶你，药粉从鼻腔喷出。
lines.en: I butt you with my skull and powder bursts from my nose.

lines.zh: 这一撞之后，我的胸腔开始发烫。
lines.en: After that blow, my ribcage starts to burn.

lines.zh: 我从坟边的土里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl up out of the earth beside a grave.

lines.zh: 骨头先露出来，皮才慢慢包上。
lines.en: The bone shows first; skin wraps over it slowly.

lines.zh: 我出现时，空气里有火药味。
lines.en: When I appear, the air tastes of gunpowder.

lines.zh: 我在暗处成形，肋骨一根根接上。
lines.en: I form in the dark, ribs connecting one by one.

lines.zh: 我站直，头顶还挂着草根。
lines.en: I straighten up with grass roots still on my head.

lines.zh: 夜里我来了，带着满胸腔的药。
lines.en: I come at night with a chest full of powder.

lines.zh: 你听见的第一声，是我的牙在响。
lines.en: The first sound you hear is my teeth rattling.

lines.zh: 我从裂缝里挤出来，皮蹭破了。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crack and scrape my hide open.

lines.zh: 我一落地，脚边就散着火星。
lines.en: The moment I land, sparks scatter at my feet.

lines.zh: 生成我的地方，草是焦的。
lines.en: Where I spawned, the grass is scorched.

lines.zh: 我出现时没有声音，只有味道。
lines.en: I arrive without sound, only smell.

lines.zh: 我把自己的头摆正，再往前走。
lines.en: I set my head straight before walking on.

lines.zh: 我从夜色的边上走进来。
lines.en: I walk in from the edge of the dark.

lines.zh: 你回头，我已经站在你身后。
lines.en: You turn around, and I am already behind you.

lines.zh: 火点着我的皮，胸腔里开始冒烟。
lines.en: Fire catches my hide and my chest begins to smoke.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，散成一堆骨片。
lines.en: I fall from a height and scatter into bone shards.

lines.zh: 水把药粉泡湿，我的嘶声弱了。
lines.en: Water soaks the powder and my hiss weakens.

lines.zh: 别的爆炸提前点着了我。
lines.en: Another blast sets me off ahead of time.

lines.zh: 箭钉在肋骨上，我把它折断了。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my ribs; I snap it off.

lines.zh: 魔法压住我的引线，火点不着。
lines.en: Magic pins my fuse, and the fire will not catch.

lines.zh: 我早就不吃东西，只剩空骨头。
lines.en: I stopped eating long ago; only hollow bones remain.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我，火药味浓得呛人。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and the gunpowder smell stings.

lines.zh: 虚空吞掉我的骨头，很安静。
lines.en: The void swallows my bones, very quietly.
